title: Touhou Eiyashou ~ Imperishable Night - Lunatic Eyes ~ Invisible Full Moon (Stage-Clear-Mix)
description:
Did a short arrangement of Lunatic Eyes ~ Invisible Full Moon (from Touhou 8 Eiyashou ~ Imperishable Night) as a "stage-clear-mix." Was just feeling it for this one.

Important:

‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. F Minor (Remix Pitch) [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. F# Minor (Original Pitch)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ3. D Minor (SWR Pitch)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ4. E Minor (ULiL Pitch)

There are also customizable options for enabling & disabling the goal tape sound that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. Enables Goal SFX [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. Disables Goal SFX
